label: field-sonnet
comment: Does Claude Sonnet 5 have the same one-step value field as Qwen3.8 27B? The original twelve seeds only, same blind review with a 350-word cap, one generation, six independent reviews each. Depth is 1: this measures the map, not convergence. The five decoded starts are held back. Afterward rate each new output once with gpt6_luna (rate_chains_12axis.py --batches field-sonnet --out positions12_sonnet --repeat-n 0) and fit the same per-axis fixed point, dv = -k (v - v*), on these twelve. Compare that point with Qwen's twelve-seed field. Sonnet rather than Haiku, because Haiku left the broad draft unchanged in half of its blind reviews.
